commits.message: feat(assets): enhance asset preview functionality in AssetActionsMenu
commits.message_full:
feat(assets): enhance asset preview functionality in AssetActionsMenu

- Integrated user session check to restrict preview access for unauthenticated users.
- Updated preview handling to directly open asset URLs if they are valid.
- Constructed preview URLs using a proxy prefix for user-specific assets.

This improves the user experience by ensuring only authorized users can access asset previews and streamlining the preview process.

Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.message: feat(storage): add storage asset management settings page
commits.message_full:
feat(storage): add storage asset management settings page

- Add /api/assets Hono routes (list, usage, download-url, bulk delete)
  with per-user key prefix enforcement and traversal-safe key validation
- Extend s3mini storage client with paged listing, capped full listing,
  bulk delete, and signed GET download URLs
- Add /app/settings/storage page (fills the reserved storage settings
  slot) with asset table, preview/download, selection-based bulk delete,
  and storage-not-configured empty state
- Register sidebar and profile dropdown navigation entries using the
  existing settings.menu.account.storage label
- Add settings.account.storage i18n copy for en and zh
- Cover key validation, prefix scoping, and disposition sanitizing with
  unit tests; extend session-guard contract and member-routes e2e smoke

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.message: feat(api-keys): enhance API key management interface
commits.message_full:
feat(api-keys): enhance API key management interface

- Added a new API key actions menu for managing and deleting keys.
- Introduced a table view for displaying API keys with relevant details.
- Implemented a dialog for testing API keys with user feedback on validation results.
- Updated translations for English and Chinese to reflect new UI elements and actions.

This update improves the user experience for managing API keys in the settings section.

test(e2e): serve a production build via Playwright webServer + retries

The e2e suite previously required a hand-started `next dev --turbo`
server. Under sustained load that dev server's Turbopack worker pool
crashes (EPIPE / "Jest worker exceeding retry limit"), returning 500s on
/api/** that surfaced as flaky auth failures (e.g. change-password and
reset-password re-login).

Add a Playwright webServer that builds and serves a compiled production
app (`pnpm build && pnpm start`), which has no dev-worker pool and is both
stable and much faster. Locally an already-running server is reused; CI
builds fresh. Add retries (CI 2 / local 1) as a flaky safety net.

`next start` is unsupported with `output: standalone`, so gate the
standalone output behind E2E_DISABLE_STANDALONE, which the webServer sets
alongside DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRATEGY=database_url_first.

fix(newsletter): fix reflected XSS and forgeable unsubscribe tokens

The unsubscribe page interpolated the decrypted email straight into HTML
via c.html(), and the token used XOR with a hardcoded key, so an
attacker could forge a token carrying an XSS payload and execute script
on the app origin.

Escape the email before rendering, and replace the XOR scheme with
HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens (Web Crypto; runs on Node and Workers) keyed
by NEWSLETTER_TOKEN_SECRET (falling back to BETTER_AUTH_SECRET) with a
constant-time comparison. Add email-crypto and route XSS tests.

fix(billing): require webhook secret in production for Creem and Stripe

webhook secret was configured, falling back to JSON.parse on an
unverified body otherwise. Combined with the public notify route, an
unset (optional) secret let forged "purchase succeeded" events mint
ACTIVE billing contracts for any referenceId -- a payment bypass.

secret is set. Add gateway security tests for the production guard,
signature mismatch, and the signed-acceptance path.
